title: AvatarPointillist: AutoRegressive 4D Gaussian Avatars from Images
summary: A framework that generates drivable 4D Gaussian avatars from a single portrait image using a decoder-only Transformer. It treats avatar generation as a sequential prediction task to achieve high-fidelity geometric details and expressions.
research_notes: Collaborative project between HKUST and Ant Group; utilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting for real-time, photorealistic rendering and animation.

evolution.summary: Accepted to CVPR 2026. It represents an evolution from earlier works like AvatarArtist and HeadArtist, moving from template-based or distillation methods to a pure autoregressive generation approach. Public code release is pending internal review.
